notes.title: v.1.0.6 - French Localisation added & Soundtrack Available to Purchase!
notes.content:
v1.0.6

- Added French Localisation thanks to Clément Mazetier
- Updated the Polish localisation with some fixes and appropriate credits

The Nocturnals soundtrack by Pablo Galbraith is now available to purchase! Although you can still listen to it free of charge on major streaming platforms, the option is on the steam page for anyone that wanted to support our next project a bit more!

notes.title: v1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed some English subtitle mistakes.
- Fixed some Spanish subtitle/choices errors.
- You can no longer glitch out of the High school.
- Fixed some "black flashes" that occurred just before a cutscene would play.
- Fixed a bug where the cutscene didn't show up in the tunnels.
- Fixed a bug where the loading screen continued to show up on top of a cutscene.
- Replaced the menu music with a new track.
- Replaced an ending music with a new track.
- Enabled access to the developer console with the tilda key (tab on Mac), once you have collected all letters and completed all endings. (Please note I will not be fixing any bugs that occur from using the developer console)
